name: The work of engineer Eladio Dieste: Church of Atlántida
description: Just 45 km from Montevideo, this 1960 church in Estación Atlántida was designed by engineer Eladio Dieste and built almost entirely of bare brick. Its walls ripple in gentle waves, carrying a matching rippling roof of thin reinforced-brick vaults. Outside stands an openwork cylindrical bell tower, while a small underground baptistery is lit from above by a round skylight.
